programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson gets in a huff and leaves the team after he is dropped from the lineup against the Blitzkrieg Boys. This leaves Kenny and Daichi to pick up the slack against their opponents. Feeling rejected, Tyson wanders off and runs into a strange old man named Tao who takes him shopping. Meanwhile the competition rolls on and the PPB All Stars are victorious. Next up, the Blitzkrieg Boys face off against the BBA Revolution without Tyson. Daichi wins his match and Kenny nervously goes to the beystadium to face his opponent Tala. During the battle, Kenny finds himself way out of his league but when Tala starts to insult Tyson he discovers his blading spirit and vows to never give up and win the match for his friend!'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In the second of a best of three match, Tala thinks he's broken Kenny down, but Kenny summons his inner strength and attacks with all of his combined power. Unfortunately, it's not enough, and Tala shatters Kenny's Hopper into pieces with his Novae Rog attack. Kenny loses the match, but in the process spots a major weakness in Tala's game. Daichi is called to take on Tala in the tie-breaker. Tyson is desperate for the win, and tries to convince Tala to let him fight in Daichi's place. Tala refuses, and Daichi is furious that Tyson has so little faith in his abilities. Meanwhile, Kenny rigs Daichi's Beyblade with a special part to help him in the battle. He convinces Daichi to follow his game plan, and stay away from Tala's 'blade until the perfect moment. Daichi agrees, but it goes against his natural style and it takes all his strength just to keep from attacking. Finally Kenny spots the opening, and Daichi takes advantage. Daichi defeats Tala, and the BBA Revolution is awarded the victory. Tyson is humbled, and vows never to underestimate his teammates again.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In Madrid for the Spanish leg of the World Championships, the hard-of-sleeping Lee has a nightmare that Ray kicks him off the team for his poor play. The day before their next match, White Tiger X encounters a pair of beyblading jugglers in Madrid's main square, who also happen to be trick bladers. When Lee criticizes their performance, he and Ray are challenged to an impromptu match. The jugglers beat them handily, which only exacerbates Lee's insecurity about his skills. Ray suspects that Lee's problem stems not only from a lack of sleep lately, but from a lack of communication between the two. Ray discusses the problem with Tyson, who suggests that Ray be more confrontational. Mr. Dickenson meanwhile, ponders whether to grant F Dynasty their request for a two-on-two match. Turns out it was Raul and Julia of F Dynasty who posed as the street jugglers in order to goad Lee and Ray. When the day of the match arrives, and White Tiger X faces F Dynasty, Lee and Ray discover the jugglers' true identities. Wanting payback for their earlier loss, Lee and Ray accept the two-on-two challenge and the match format is set. F Dynasty dominates the contest, causing Lee to go batty in fear of letting Ray down yet again. Coming loose at the seams, Lee's reckless blading becomes a serious concern. To save his fragile-minded teammate from further distress, Ray knocks out Lee's blade himself and accept his team's loss. Discussing the incident afterward, Lee acknowledges his mistake, and he and Ray vow to be more communicative in the future.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As Max prepares to face Kai in the next round, the members of BBA Revolution overhear a confrontation between Johnny and Robert of the Majestics and Barthez Battalion. It turns out Barthez Battalion won their qualifying tournament through trickery. Thanks to Kenny, the teams find proof of Barthez's underhanded tactics but it's too late to disqualify them from the Championships. Armed with his new Draciel Gravity, Max takes Kai to the edge of defeat only to end up defeated himself. Rick uses his frustration at the loss to overcome Tala and goes on to face Kai in a tiebreaker. Despite his great power, Rick loses to the more experienced Kai. Inspired by the match, Tyson vows to face Barthez Battalion with everything he's got.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution are slated to face the sneaky Barthez Battalion, but while Hilary and Kenny want to report their dirty deeds to the authorities, Tyson believes the best way to teach them a lesson is to beat them fair and square'But that's before he really sees how low the team will sink to win. When Mathilda blows up her beyblade on purpose, just to cause damage to Daichi's Strata Dragoon, Tyson and his team are shocked'But Tyson stands his ground! Although Daichi wants to give Jean Paul Barthez himself a piece of his mind'Tyson holds him back, knowing that all will be decided in the beyblade dish'or will it? Tyson prepares to face off against Miguel, but how will he fare against the team leader's own dirty tricks'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes land in Egypt for the next leg of the tournament where the first two teams going up against each other are the Blitzkrieg Boys against the Barthez Battalion. But as Barthez readies his team, we learn he's devised a special spider web-like tape that is supposed to shoot out of his team's blades and trap their opponents in an inescapable web. Miguel is torn and knows that if they follow his coach's plan they could win, but he feels he'd rather lose with respect than cheat. In the first battle, Aaron goes up against Tala. Barthez tells his players to just act natural and he would operate the spider webbing by remote control. As the battle begins, Barthez desperately pushes the remote control, but nothing happens. Turns out Aaron refused to use the 'fixed' blade. Barthez is furious. Miguel is defiant and tell Barthez that they aren't going to be 'his puppets anymore.' As Barthez leaves, Miguel steps into the ring against Kai. The battle doesn't last very long as Kai wins handily. But Miguel has lost with dignity and that's just the way he wants it!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is having trouble convincing Rick that he is truly dedicated to the PPB All Starz. Max just wants to play for love of the game but Rick thinks he should do anything to win. When the competition continues Max demands they fight a 'pairs' match so that he and Rick are forced to work as a team. Rick's ego gets the best of him and soon he finds himself not only battling the White Tiger X team but Max as well. Mariah tells Ray and Lee of White Tiger X that they should battle each other and find out who is the best blader out of the four of them. A beyblading free for all ensues until the final climactic battle when only one blade is left spinning. The winner is surprised as everyone else to learn that he is the best blader of them all!'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Egyptian leg of the World Championships culminates with the final match highlighting F Dynasty against the BBA Revolution. The day before the match, Tyson has Daichi practice moves with him that they're not usually accustomed to doing: namely, tag-team attacks. F Dynasty is renowned for their tag-team abilities, and Tyson wants nothing more than to beat them at their own game. He knows this will be a challenge, as F Dynasty has already used the tag-team format to defeat White Tiger X earlier in the tournament. But as the former Beyblade world champion, Tyson feels it's his duty to prove that he's the best, no matter what the format is. F Dynasty meanwhile, foregoes practicing in favor of another fantastic street show of their beyblading skills for a crowd of onlookers. In a flashback to their childhood, we learn that Raul and Julia have been performing as a duo since their formative years growing up in the circus. The introduction of beyblades to their act only solidified their skills. When the day of the match arrives, Tyson specifically requests the two-on-two format and F Dynasty agrees. The sand-filled Sahara dish gives Tyson and Daichi the pre-battle advantage, but during the match, Tyson's beyblade has trouble keeping up. Coach Hiro realizes that the pressure Tyson is feeling to carry his team as the former Beyblade champion is affecting his performance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is feeling the pressure of being World Champion. Despite Hiro's warning, a television crew follows him around for a day, taping his every move. Daichi feels jealous and tries to compete for the camera's attention. Finally, BBA Revolution holds a three-way match between Tyson, Daichi and Kenny for the cameras and Tyson loses like an amateur. Tyson contemplates quitting and wanders to the Beystadium to be alone with his thoughts. Daichi confronts him and challenges him to a match. During the beybattle, Tyson is reminded of how it feels to beyblade for the pure love of the game. The pressure disappears when Tyson realizes he doesn't have to beyblade like a champion. He just has to beyblade like himself! Tyson meets Kai, Max and Ray ands tells them that, from now on, they are all challengers and any one of them could end up as champion.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final elimination round is underway, with F Dynasty trying to earn the last play-off slot, while their opponents, the already mathematically eliminated Barthez Battalion try to spoil their chances. Feeling like the weak link of the team, Raul surprises Julia by insisting he battle solo for F Dynasty, in order to prove his worth. Julia reluctantly agrees. In the first match Julia easily defeats Miguel, piling even more pressure on Raul. Raul is up against Mathilda of Barthez Battalion (who is using a combination of parts from her team's Beyblades) in the second match. Raul freezes under the pressure, and it looks like he is a sitting duck. But Julia steps in to explain to Raul that the only reason she has so much confidence in battle is because she has him at her side. This fires Raul up, and he battles back to steal the victory. The Barthez Battalion team are eliminated, but they are very gracious in defeat.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Ray And Kai: The Ultimate Face-Off
programme.desc: With Lee losing to Tala early in the match, White Tiger X is a game down, and Kai now steps up to battle for the Blitzkrieg Boys. This round is sure to be intense, as old teammates face off in the dish. Ray will represent White Tiger X, and the world is watching. The pressure seems too much for the players, as Ray collapses from the strain. Somehow he finds the strength to keep going, and the desire to bring Kai down! The intensity rises as the battle continues, with both players on either side of the dish so evenly matched, who can predict which one will walk away with the victory?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The fight is a tough one. In fact, the combatants are going at it so hard that the entire arena is filled with the acrid smell of burnt metal. This seems to be a battle of wills rather than blades as each Blader attempts to summon every ounce of power that they can. In the end, Daichi proves to be the winner, and Rick is devastated. Daichi on the other hand has used so much energy that he passes out. Now it's time for the next round, and it pits Tyson against his former teammate, Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: When You Wish Upon A Star
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: There's Something About A Soldier
programme.desc: This flag-waving Columbia programmer concentrates on five young Officer's Candidate School applicants. Each of the protagonists aspires to an officer's commission in the Anti-Artillery Aircraft Command. All the clichéd characterizations are in attendance, from the brash show-off (Tom Neal) to the seen-it-all veteran (Bruce Bennett). Evelyn Keyes is the obligatory romantic lead, while future "Ward Cleaver" Hugh Beaumont shows up as a hard-nosed lieutenant. There's Something About a Soldier was largely filmed on location at the OCS training headquarters of Camp Davis, North Carolina. Excerpts from the film were later reused in Columbia's The Racket Man, which also starred Tom Neal.

Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. programme.title: Un Bebé Ante Su Majestad
programme.desc: Mientras juega al escondite, Bebé Pitufo se esconde en una cesta que acaba en el río. Bebé Pitufo flota hasta la tierra de las haditas del Bosque de los Sauces. Sin embargo, los desagradables y estúpidos Verrugosos reaccionan de forma extraña al ver al bebé.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El último invento conjunto de Pitufo Goloso y Pitufo Carpintero es una suave y refrescante delicia que deciden llamar pituficrema, y que los humanos conocemos como helado. Todo sería genial si la rivalidad no hubiese surgido entre ambos Pitufos… ¡y si Gargamel no se esforzara tanto por ser desagradable!

programme.title: Los Visitantes
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa pequeña luna que ha llegado del cielo? Es un globo de barro cubierto de cráteres y habitado por los Lodosos, una familia de criaturas que vienen del cielo y comen y salpican barro. No todos los Pitufos demuestran entusiasmo por los visitantes….

programme.title: La Belleza Es Superficial
programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: El Pitufador Pitufomático
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel sigue queriendo destruir a los Pitufos. Esta vez, envía al bosque las semillas de una planta trepadora que enredará a todos los Pitufos. Sin embargo, Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un Pitufador Pitufomático….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su plan por librarse de los Pitufos, Gargamel le lanza un hechizo a Gigantón y se disfraza de Pitufo. Creyendo que es un Pitufo, Gigantón está a punto de destrozar por completo la Aldea Pitufa hasta que Papá Pitufo acude con una cura.

programme.title: El Amigo Más Pitufo
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo tenía un amigo: Pitufo Torpe. Pero el pobre Pitufo Torpe es tan… bueno, torpe, que Pitufo Filósofo no quiere volverle a ver. Así que ahora no queda nadie dispuesto a escucharle. Quizá Buddy, el apuesto diablillo que ha conocido por casualidad cerca del gran roble, pueda convertirse en amigo de Pitufo Filósofo….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel consigue transformar una colcha en una alfombra voladora, lo que hace inevitable que se produzcan accidentes. El resultado de uno de esos accidentes es que un trozo de la tela voladora acaba utilizándose como pañal para Bebé Pitufo, con resultados realmente sorprendentes….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Por fin hay un puesto digno del gran talento y la enorme experiencia de Gargamel. Al menos, eso es lo que el malvado mago piensa cuando descubre que el príncipe Teodoro necesita un nuevo mago para su corte. Los Pitufos se muestran encantados cuando ven que Gargamel y su inútil aprendiz Escrupuloso dejan su choza del bosque. Pero quizá se están alegrando demasiado pronto. ¿Quién sabe qué treta les puede tener reservada Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pantano de Greenpeedeepee es el único lugar donde se pueden encontrar unas algas que son el delicioso e imprescindible ingrediente del famoso estofado de algas de Pitufo Goloso. Desafortunadamente, también es un lugar donde te puedes topar con los desagradables Verrugosos. A pesar de que Sasita y los Pitufos le salvan la vida a un joven Verrugoso, acaban siendo apresados por los demás. ¡Pero el Enmascarado Escarlata los salvará! Quizá….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus… Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto crédito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la primera Navidad de Pitufo Salvaje y está impresionado por la decoración de la Aldea Pitufa. Pero Abuelo Pitufo y Sasita van a enseñarle el auténtico significado de la Navidad cuando ayudan a una pareja de ancianos a disfrutar de la Navidad más hermosa que jamás hayan vivido….

programme.title: El Cuerno De La Abundancia
programme.desc: Madre Naturaleza siempre da lo mejor de sí misma, pero esta vez algo ha salido mal. Su varita no funciona según lo previsto y daña por accidente la cosecha otoñal. Ahora, los Pitufos y todos los animales del bosque se enfrentan a la escasez y el hambre de cara al invierno. El único lugar donde los Pitufos podrían obtener comida sería la Tierra de la Abundancia. Sin embargo, Gargamel roba el famoso Cuerno de la Abundancia para tender una trampa a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha tenido una nueva y revolucionaria idea: una especie de carro que se mueve sobre raíles y no requiere que los Pitufos tiren de él. Lo llama pitufitren y hace que la vida en la aldea resulte menos cansada… hasta que Gargamel lo descubre.

programme.title: El Libro De Bromas De Bromista
programme.desc: Las cajas sorpresa de Pitufo Bromista ya no resultan divertidas para los demás Pitufos. Pitufo Bromista busca nuevas ideas en su «Gran libro de las bromas», pero esas ideas son aún peor recibidas en la aldea. Y entonces, Gargamel llega con algunas bromas de su propia cosecha….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Pitufo En Rascacielos
programme.desc: Está claro que una aldea de casas con forma de seta es bonita y alegre… Sin embargo, no resulta muy moderna a los ojos de Pitufo Arquitecto. Lo que los Pitufos necesitan es un rascacielos, un nuevo y atrevido concepto que cambiará su forma de vivir para siempre….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata….

programme.title: El Pitufo Reportero
programme.desc: Pitufo Curioso ha tenido una idea: ¿por qué no imprimir un boletín con todas las noticias de la aldea? Está seguro de que sus cotilleos sobre los Pitufos interesarán a todos los lectores. Pero las cosas no salen exactamente según lo previsto cuando Papá Pitufo encuentra superpitufrutas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: El Regreso De Don Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando una gota de la nueva poción de Papá Pitufo cae en el libro de aventuras de los Pitufitos, el héroe de ficción cobra vida. El intrépido Don Pitufo, que desea deshacer a los Pitufos del malvado Gargamel, lo captura con valentía….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Chitter, la ardilla favorita de Pitufo Salvaje, ha desaparecido misteriosamente y eso hace que se sienta muy solo. Vaga desolado por la aldea y su mirada solo se ilumina cuando Pitufina está cerca. Los otros Pitufos también detectan el repentino interés de Pitufina….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Mago Mas Rapido Del Mundo
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado mago, ha llegado a la conclusión bastante evidente de que, si fuera capaz de correr más rápido, podría atrapar a más Pitufos. Mientras elabora una nueva fórmula, en la aldea, a los Pitufos les gustaría que Pitufo Salvaje se tomara las cosas con más calma….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Si hay algo que la malvada hechicera Clorhidris no puede soportar es la felicidad de las demás personas. Contemplar la vida de los Pitufos, llena de amabilidad y canciones, pone furiosa a Clorhidris. Debe destruir esas risas y ahogar esas felices conversaciones… Entonces, planta la raíz del mal en el bosque y, poco después, todos los Pitufos dejan de hablarse. El único que no se ha visto afectado es Bebé Pitufo….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Viaje Al Pitufo De La Tierra
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado a la Aldea Pitufa. Y los pequeños Pitufos están helados de frío. ¿Pero qué está haciendo Pitufo Torpe con esa extraña roca que ha descubierto? ¿Y por qué está tan entusiasmado Pitufo Minero con su nuevo descubrimiento? Nadie entiende a qué se debe tanto revuelo por una simple nueva roca para la colección de Pitufo Torpe… Al adentrarse bajo tierra, los Pitufos encontrarán peligros y sorpresas.

programme.title: La Novia De Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Brenda, la pequeña bruja, se siente rechazada: nadie la quiere llevar al Baile de las Escobas de este año. Ay, si pudiera encontrar a algún chico guapo… Entonces conoce a Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. Es muy apuesto, ¡y está libre! Lo que ella no sabe es que Escrupuloso solamente está interesado en su varita mágica. Y lo que saben los Pitufos es que la van a ayudar a salir del aprieto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No es culpa suya. Pitufo Torpe nunca deja de provocar catástrofes, e incluso cuando Papá Pitufo le manda al bosque a hacer un recado, vuelve acompañado de una nube de mala suerte cuya sombra causa infortunios a cualquiera (o a cualquier Pitufo) que esté bajo ella… Papá Pitufo tendrá que echar mano de todos sus recursos para encontrar una cura ¡y encontrar la cara brillante que cada nube oscura debería tener!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las preocupaciones de Papá Pitufo hacen que le salgan verrugas. La única forma de librarle de esta enfermedad causada por la indecisión es que frote el cuerno de uno de los Verrugosos, los desaliñados, viscosos, estúpidos y brutales enemigos de las haditas del Bosque de los Sauces….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Fiesta De Pijamas Para Perezoso
programme.desc: ¡Pobre Pitufo Perezoso! Todo lo que desea es una buena noche de descanso. Pero no: todos los Pitufos celebran una fiesta en su honor y, lo que es peor, se ve arrastrado a una absurda discusión sobre pintar los dedos de los pies de Gigantón de un brillante color mandarina. ¡Va a ser una larga noche en vela para el pobre Pitufo Perezoso!

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos….

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Regreso De Los Ojos Azules
programme.desc: Esta vez, el siniestro plan de Gargamel ha funcionado demasiado bien. Tan solo quería una pequeña inundación que ahogase a los Pitufos. Pero casi provoca el fin del mundo, y los Pitufos tienen que construir un arca para sobrevivir. ¿Llegará a tiempo el pequeño caballo alado, el amigo de Pitufina?

programme.title: Un Bebé Ante Su Majestad
programme.desc: Mientras juega al escondite, Bebé Pitufo se esconde en una cesta que acaba en el río. Bebé Pitufo flota hasta la tierra de las haditas del Bosque de los Sauces. Sin embargo, los desagradables y estúpidos Verrugosos reaccionan de forma extraña al ver al bebé.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: C&O at the Beach - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Kenny Roger's Family Values - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Emma finds her legal methods are different from Darcy’s, and frustration ensues until both can stop to understand the other’s perspective.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.sub-title: Hit Me With Your Best Shot
programme.desc: Lizzie deals with coordinating her family’s wardrobe for a family portrait, with constant resistance to her ideas and suggestions of wild animal prints from her mother. Marianne gets a job at Yum Divine (a dessert bistro of sorts), but repeatedly messes up to the point of having her new job on the chopping block. Through Elinor’s insistence, and everyone’s help, Marianne hangs on to her job—barely. Grant figures out that Emma’s love of match-making comes as a therapy for all the divorce cases she handles. He recounts all the terrible dates Emma has sent him on. Lizzie learns that Grant might just love Emma.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: April Monroe is a superstar doctor at a big New York hospital, who has fallen head-over-heels for charming veterinarian Jesse, and their relationship seems to be heading in the right direction except for one thing: Jesse is completely tight-lipped about his Amish family.

programme.title: Romantic Rewrite
programme.desc: Ivy is a romance book editor, up for a promotion at work but tasked with helping a stubborn mystery writer incorporate romance successfully into the next book in his series. He volunteers to be Ivy’s faux date for her best friend’s beach wedding in return for Ivy’s editing skills.

programme.title: Art Of Falling In Love
programme.desc: An artist painting a mural on a new hospital wing falls for the project's architect but worries he may not want to be with her if she reveals the unfortunate story behind her secret bucket list.

programme.title: Love in Tahiti
programme.desc: Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Christmas Roses
programme.desc: A young girl struggling with grief and a lonely woman who has shut herself off from the world find their lives unexpectedly intertwined. As the magic of Christmas weaves through their hearts, they discover that love, forgiveness, and second chances are the greatest gifts of all.

programme.title: Mi Romance Perfecto
programme.desc: La desarrolladora de tecnología Vivian Blair cree que ha desarrollado el algoritmo de citas definitivo, comparando la huella digital de dos personas y calculando la probabilidad de amor. Ella lo llama, ¡Mi pareja perfecta! Wes Robinson, jefe de la división de tecnología de Robinson Tech, está luchando por encontrar ideas innovadoras para impulsar las ventas de la compañía. Wes ve potencial tanto en Vivian como en su algoritmo y decide lanzar la aplicación, a pesar de chocar con su madre ... quien es la directora ejecutiva.

programme.title: Misión Amor
programme.desc: Mackenzie viaja a Costa Rica por su trabajo. Su mejor amigo, Ethan, la acompaña para inspirarse en su novela de acción y aventura. Mackenzie ama a Ethan desde hace mucho tiempo, pero él sólo la ve como una amiga, hasta que un turista llamado Lucas hace que Ethan vea a Mackenzie bajo una nueva luz.

programme.title: El Amor Y La Estrella de Radio
programme.desc: Savannah es contratada para renovar la imagen del presentador del programa de radio número 4 de Nueva York. programme.title: Encontrando El Amor En Charm

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Clayton and Skyler kick off the season by putting in the work—prepping stands, checking setups, and getting everything ready for another fall in the whitetail woods. As the pre-rut starts to pick up, he finally gets his chance on a good buck, but things don’t go as planned. It’s never an easy thing to experience as a bowhunter, but there’s only one thing you can do—learn from it and get right back after it. Not long after, Clayton finds himself with another opportunity, this time on an absolute MEGA 8 point. When the moment finally comes, he settles in and makes a perfect shot. programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Asia resolve que irá tentar atrapalhar o relacionamento entre Samantha e Daniel. Os moradores da casa do "Are You The One?" têm uma última chance de conseguirem amor, dinheiro e mais um dia para lidarem com as consequências do que fizeram.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Pela primeira vez na história, o amor não tem limites e todos são uma opção para os 16 solteiros que desembarcam no Havaí para encontrar um amor e ganhar R$1,000,000.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: O paraíso já começa apresentar os primeiros sinais do inferno que está por vir. Um casal tem problemas devido a possibilidade de um relacionamento aberto. Triângulos amorosos começam a surgir na casa.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Depois do baile LGBTQ+, a casa fica literal e figurativamente uma bagunça. A bruxa está solta para dois casais da casa. Dionne Slay chega no recinto.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Um ménage a cinco agita a dinâmica. A tendência autodestrutiva do Justin ameaça sua relação com Max. Danny faz uma conexão.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A casa está determinada em descobrir qual dos casais é um par ideal. Jonathan está determinado em romper as barreiras do amor. Kai apronta na frente da Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Jonathan tenta fazer as pazes com Basit. Um casal se aproxima enquanto outros lutam para superar seus comportamentos tóxicos na relação.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Amigos e familiares colocam a casa abaixo. Jenna está dividida entre a estratégia e seu coração. Uma visita ao Quarto do Sexo tem consequências explosivas.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: A casa tenta consertar os estragos causados pelo comportamento predatório do Kai que causou muita confusão. Remy tenta deixar seu passado de pegação pra trás para conquistar a Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Três casais encontram os seus pares ideais enquanto dois casais têm péssimas notícias. Justin e Max encontram a resposta que procuravam. Paige luta para derrubar suas barreiras.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O motorista Chris Valderas fica severamente ferido em um acidente de carro e a equipe de médicos da emergência trabalha duro para salvar a sua vida. Uma garota chinesa de 6 anos é levada às pressas à emergência com convulsões graves e contínuas.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Quando Kassie Arner de 11 anos de idade chega ao hospital infantil de Phoenix, o pediatra da UTI acha que ela irá morrer. Os paramédicos levam ao hospital uma garota adolescente que se recusa a falar e aparentemente está com medo de se mexer.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Depois de sofrer maus-tratos severos, a jovem e linda Anne chega ao hospital com ferimentos que ameaçam a sua vida e com metade do seu rosto desfigurado. Uma mulher rica chega à emergência se queixando de tontura e confusão.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma jovem desorientada e fantasiada de coelhinho chega à emergência. Uma médica não consegue tratar de um corte na mão de seu namorado. Um jovem perde a sensibilidade das pernas… ou será que não?

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem foi esmagado por uma caçamba e escapa da morte. Uma freira idosa e uma prostituta embriagada, que não para de gritar, chegam à emergência na mesma hora. Uma mulher que está quase morrendo por causa de um derrame pode ter uma doença rara.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher com chiados chega à emergência com problemas respiratórios. Um homem adulto repentinamente começa a agir como criança. Uma festa de aniversário tem problemas quando a família toda vai parar na emergência fatalmente doente.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma madrinha de casamento entra em um perigoso coma alcoólico. As pupilas de um homem incham. Um bebê prematuro é deixado no banheiro do hospital e precisa ser rapidamente reanimado na emergência.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma estudante desmaia na emergência e os médicos fazem RCP por horas na esperança de que ela sobreviva. Um homem com uma ereção de cinco horas é encontrado entre a sua esposa e sua amante e uma avó de 70 anos acorda depois de ser declarada morta.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um homem leva uma picada fatal de uma cascavel, mas por razões religiosas não pode receber uma transfusão de sangue. Será que ele sobreviverá?

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Um prisioneiro pode estar fingindo paralisia para fugir da prisão. Um jovem parece estar sufocado sem razão. Um pai é esfaqueado no coração quando tenta proteger seu filho. Uma líder de torcida da faculdade tem uma parada cardíaca misteriosa.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Pedaços de Vidro de 12 Centímetros no Cérebro. Coágulo Sanguíneo Assassino. Suicida Com Arma. O Paciente Border Collie. Aguentando Firme no Pronto-Socorro.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma médica da emergência fica em perigo por conta de uma paciente violento. Uma dor de cabeça inexplicável pode ser fatal. Um homem com um ferro enfiado em seu tronco é levado à emergência no meio da noite.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Beba Água que Passa. O Braço Vs. o Aparador de Grama. A Garota Doida da Cabeça Machucada. Acidente de Carro de Adolescente.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: Uma mulher é socorrida de um incêndio e tem um ataque cardíaco na emergência. Um paciente esquizofrênico acredita que está com o rosto de outra pessoa e um estudante de medicina não treinado é confundido com um médico e precisa fazer um parto.

programme.title: Pronto-Socorro: Histórias de Emergência
programme.desc: O Acidente de Moto. A Triagem dos Quatro Skatistas. O Tribunal Exigiu Transfusão. O Médico Cuida De Quem Precisa de Remédio.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold arrisca ser expulso da escola ao liderar uma greve contra as novas regras que ele acha serem "injustas."

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Drummond é um pilar de força para Sam, quando ele se prepara para retirar as amídalas, mas o que acontecerá quando Drummond descobrir que será companheiro de quarto de Sam quando ele se submeter a uma "pequena" cirurgia de joelho?

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Arnold acha que a feira de ciências da escola é a chance ideal para sabotar o projeto de sua colega de sala menos favorita, mas ao olhar de perto, ele se pergunta se as grosserias dela não são, na verdade, um grito de socorro.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold é indicado juiz do tribunal escolar, ele logo enfrenta o risco de perder uma amizade de longa data ou perder um encontro com uma gatinha da escola - todos terão a sua chance no tribunal.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Arnold e Sam se rastejam através das fendas da casa assombrada do bairro, eles descobrem que o fantasma possui diversas surpresas - a maior de todas é um amor pelas pessoas e desprezo para a guerra.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando Sam visita uma gravação de "The Sandy Squirrel Show", ele fica arrasado com a notícia de que seu programa de TV favorito está prestes a ser cancelado.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam deve escolher entre uma cobertura e um boteco quando o seu verdadeiro pai bate à porta de Drummond, querendo levar o Sam com ele. Cantor/compositor Hoyt Axton é o convidado especial no papel do pai de Sam, Wes McKinney.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: "O Gooch" volta para provocar o Arnold e mira em um novo alvo -- Sam -- só para enfrentar o seu novo desafio contra o novo vizinho de Drummond, uma estudante de intercâmbio italiana.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Visando ser eleito diretor de entretenimento para um fundo de caridade escolar, Arnold promete conseguir uma celebridade -- mas quando chega a hora, ele é forçado a pedir ajuda à sua inimiga Carmella, esperando que ela possa salvar o dia.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O empreendedor Arnold reluta em permitir que Sam faça parte do seu novo esquema, quando Sam percebe que apenas Arnold ficará com os lucros, ele acaba com a parceria e vira um concorrente.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma surpresa de Drummond, destinada a animar uma esperança olímpica caída em um trágico acidente, tem o efeito oposto, já que o jovem fica amargurado no encontro dos medalhistas de ouro.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Os Drummond ficam preocupados quando o normalmente adorável Sam luta contra um cínico idoso que rejeita o programa dos escoteiros "Adote um Avô", deixando Sam com uma imagem errada das pessoas mais velhas.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam convence um relutante Sr. Drummond a se tornar o treinador do seu fracassado time de basquete e depois se arrepende quando ele aparece no banco de reservas.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam é pego de surpresa quando ele percebe que seu novo "colega" é uma menina, mas o Sr. Drummond fica ainda mais boquiaberto quando os garotos desejam fazer uma festa de pijama.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Kimberly volta para casa de sua escola em Paris para surpreender Drummond em seu aniversário, fazendo com que Arnold e Willis tentem combinar aquele presente especial até que Willis pense em algo melhor.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Quando o foguete do projeto de Arnol para a escola é acidentalmente disparado e pousa sobre a embaixada russa, o departamento de estado é levado a suspeitar da participação de Drummond em algum ato criminoso.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: A tentativa de Arnold para impedir que um amigo beba dá errado, quando ele é deixado diante do banheiro masculino segurando uma garrafa de bebida no momento em que um professor chega, em um episódio especial que lida com o alcoolismo na adolescência.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma viagem para acampamento com Arnold e Sam que tinha a intenção de fortalecer o relacionamento de Drummond com Sam dá errado quando o verdadeiro pai de Sam aparece e o convida a se juntar a ele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.sub-title: A beleza está nos olhos de Arnold
programme.desc: Arnold se vê diante de um dilema quando seus amigos insistem para que ele chame uma linda chefe de torcida para dançar, ao invés da garota que Arnold realmente gosta, a qual eles consideram uma "patinha feia."

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Após ser assaltado no caminho da escola para casa, Arnold insiste para que Sam e Willis não contem ao Sr. Drummond.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: A nova amizade de Arnold e Sam com uma dançarina de rua fica repleta de medo e confusão quando eles descobrem que ela tem epilepsia.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Sam e Arnold temem que o tempo que seus pais estão passando separados seja sintoma de um casamento que está ruindo e os meninos tentam reacender o romance deles, esperando que seja a solução para evitar o divórcio.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Proteger Ramona, a namorada do valentão da escola, parece uma tarefa simples para Arnold, até que seu "charme Jackson" natural cria alguns problemas - Ramona se apaixona perdidamente por ele - e Herman, o valentão, quer arrebentar a cara dele.

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: O sonho de Arnold de se tornar um sucesso "da noite para o dia" como fotojornalista se torna realidade quando ele consegue seu primeiro emprego em um jornal local.x

programme.title: Arnold: Minha Família é uma bagunça
programme.desc: Uma família cujo filho pequeno morreu, obriga o pai a sequestrar Sam, que está comprando salgadinhos em uma mercearia.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Jonathan incentiva os moradores de um bairro a se unirem contra um desenvolvedor de coração frio.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Jonathan inspira um jovem a ajudar o avô que recentemente foi internado em uma casa de repouso.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Lizzy MacGill é a filha de um treinador de cavalos que foge com Garth Armstrong, um homem privilegiado.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Jonathan e Mark tentam ajudar Lizzie. A nova noiva tem câncer e está grávida.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Mark e Jonathan tornam-se conselheiros em um acampamento para crianças com câncer.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Jonathan e Mark estão ajudando os pacientes do Camp Good Times de maneiras diferentes. Mas um pai ainda se recusa a lidar com a doença do filho.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Jonathan abre mão de seus poderes angelicais por um tempo e percebe os perigos que Mark enfrentou por ser um policial.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Uma aspirante a atriz quer ser aceita por quem ela realmente é, e não pela imagem que seu pai bem-intencionado tenta transformá-la.

programme.title: O Homem Que Veio do Céu
programme.desc: Mark foi enganado para vender sua alma para salvar a vida de uma menina. Mas o Diabo tem outra agenda: adquirir a alma de Jonathan.

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações

programme.title: Assombrações
